"""Small text helpers.

``slugify_title`` turns a free-form title into a URL/identifier-safe slug.

The slug is deliberately ASCII-only: anything outside ``[a-z0-9]`` (including
non-ASCII letters such as ``é`` or ``日``) is treated as a separator and
collapsed into a hyphen. We do not transliterate and add no dependency, so the
output is stable and predictable across platforms and locales.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import re

_NON_SLUG_RUN = re.compile(r"[^a-z0-9]+")


def slugify_title(title: str) -> str:
    """Return a lowercase ASCII slug for ``title`` (may be ``""``)."""
    return _NON_SLUG_RUN.sub("-", title.lower().strip()).strip("-")
EOF

        ("   ", ""),

        ("2024 Q3 report", "2024-q3-report"),
        ("Café au lait", "caf-au-lait"),
        ("Über", "ber"),
        ("日本語", ""),
        ("日本語 notes", "notes"),
    ],
)
def test_slugify_title(title: str, expected: str) -> None:
    assert slugify_title(title) == expected
EOF
